text: Using the default assumed payment date of 2026-11-10, INV-2’s tranche and Build & integrations move 16 days; the later tranche and Launch & handover move 9 days. Schedule-change and payment-reminder approval cards are waiting for the owner; nothing has been applied or sent yet.
